title: "Alla Igityan puts a happy spin on breakup and heartache with 'Better'
htmlContent: Alla Igityan captures this uplifting idea that breakups don't always have to be sad. Sometimes, they can lead to amazing new beginnings in her cheerful folk song, "Better." With a warm and easy melody, the lyrics transform heartache into strength, making it a comforting song for anyone struggling to move on. Igityan's voice is warm and inviting, effortlessly mixing heartfelt emotion with a spirited sense of resilience. Instead of focusing on what's been lost, she celebrates the freedom and clarity of letting go. The music is natural and lively, with a folk-inspired sound that stands out. Gentle acoustic guitars create a soothing rhythm, while light percussion keeps the energy up. https://open.spotify.com/track/0m3tBCjc1BtkTRWRCgiXjl The music and lyrics carry a sense of moving forward, showing the emotional journey from heartbreak to healing. "Better" reminds us that sometimes, what seems like the end is actually a new beginning. If you've ever struggled to get over someone, Igityan's song is the perfect remedy, encouraging you to embrace the positive side of moving on.
excerpt: Alla Igityan’s latest single “Better” flips the script on heartbreak, offering an upbeat and empowering take on moving forward after love lost.
